# MinimizeWindow

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Windows](BlitzPlus-Windows)

</div>


```blitzbasic
MinimizeWindow:Void window:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `window` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a window. |

## Description

Hides a window as if it were put into the task bar. Its gadgets keep their state. [RestoreWindow](RestoreWindow) shows it again and [WindowMinimized](WindowMinimized) tells if it is hidden.

## Differences

* The operating system minimizes the window and brings it back from its task bar; without a window manager nothing happens. Where the windows are drawn inside the window of `Graphics`, a minimized window is a bar at the bottom of that window, which the user clicks to restore it.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Hide and seek", 40, 40, 200, 100, Desktop(), 15)
MinimizeWindow win
If WindowMinimized(win) Then RestoreWindow win
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
